Own technical escalations through completion, coordinating cross-functionally with Engineering, Operations, People, and external vendors. Troubleshoot and resolve login, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and lockout issues. Manage account provisioning, modification, and deprovisioning across cloud platforms during onboarding, offboarding, and role changes following defined workflows. Process access and permission adjustments in accordance with internal approvals and security standards. Maintain MFA systems, assisting employees with device setup, resets, and enrollment. Conduct routine user access reviews and security audits using system-generated account reports. Maintain accurate inventory records for user accounts, hardware, software, and licenses. Maintain and update IT runbooks, checklists, and documentation for a remote workforce. Partner with internal teams to identify patterns and prevent recurring technical issues. Required Qualifications 3–5 years of experience in IT support, help desk, or IT operations. Demonstrated track record of high ticket throughput and dependable issue resolution in a support setting. Hands-on experience with cloud-based identity and access management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, permission changes, and MFA administration. Proficiency supporting macOS and PC operating environments. Experience utilizing mobile device management tools such as Rippling, Mosyle, or Jamf. Proficiency with collaboration platforms including Slack, Zoom, and Google Workspace. Proven troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, and cloud applications in a remote setting. Strong communication and customer service skills suited for supporting a distributed team. Preferred Qualifications Degree or professional certifications in information technology.
